secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key for AI sports analyst features. Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com) > API keys. Without it, AI chat falls back to simulated responses.

secrets.name: SPORTSDATA_API_KEY
secrets.description: SportsData.io Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key for live NFL API feeds. Get it from SportsData.io > My Account > API Keys. Without it, the app uses mock data.
